title: Zerostel guardrails (~/.zerostel/policy.json)
description: Rules that stop a tool call, or make the agent ask you first, before it runs. Deny wins over ask.

action.description: deny: the tool call never runs and the agent is told why. ask: Claude Code asks you; agents that can't ask block it and say so.

paths.description: Files a tool names, including paths in shell commands. ~/ is your home folder; other relative globs start at the project root. ** crosses folders, * doesn't; dir/** includes dir itself.

commands.description: Each part of a shell command (split at && || ; | & ( ) $( ) and backticks), case-insensitive. * matches anything.

tools.description: Tool names, e.g. WebFetch or mcp__github__delete_*.

access.description: write: paths only count for tools that can change files.

reason.description: Shown to the agent and in the timeline.
